description: This file defines a serializer class 'VersionCodec' for serializing and deserializing the System.Version type in a Orleans serialization context. It also defines a surrogate struct 'VersionSurrogate' used during the serialization process.

classes.name: VersionCodec
classes.description: Serializer for the System.Version type, providing conversion to and from a surrogate for serialization.

classes.name: VersionSurrogate
classes.description: A surrogate struct for the Version class, containing major, minor, build, and revision components with associated serialization IDs.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a VersionSurrogate instance back into a Version object.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Converts a Version object into a VersionSurrogate instance.

methods.name: VersionCodec
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the VersionCodec with a surrogate serializer.
